# TotalLossToolkit

> Independent market data reports and free guides to help vehicle owners dispute undervalued total loss insurance settlements.

## Core Pages
- [Home](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/): Landing page explaining the total loss problem and how TotalLossToolkit helps owners challenge lowball settlements
- [Pricing](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/pricing): One-time-purchase report tiers — Basic ($19) and Premium ($25) — via LemonSqueezy, no subscription
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/knowledge-base): 22 free educational articles covering total loss law, claims tactics, and state-specific rules
- [Professional Directory](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/directory): Searchable directory of independent appraisers, public adjusters, and insurance advocates
- [FAQ](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/faq): How total loss is determined, how reports work, how to dispute a settlement, state-specific rules
- [Guarantee](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/guarantee): Premium Report money-back guarantee — refund if your settlement does not increase by more than the report cost

## Reports
- [Start a Report](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/reports/new): Enter a VIN to begin a comparable vehicle valuation report

## Optional
- [llms-full.txt](https://www.totallosstoolkit.com/llms-full.txt): Complete site content and all article descriptions for AI systems
